title: Gmail-style email domains
statementMd:
Show each customer's name and the part of their email after the `@` sign.

Expected columns: `name`, `domain`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, substr(email, instr(email, '@') + 1) AS domain FROM customers;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
